answer: Slot depth tax: each agent's per-block gas fee scales with its rank in the creator's account list, so an ocean of clones pushes every new ID into a costlier slot. The fable is that the protocol re-reads the funding graph each epoch and re-sorts, shoving the attacker's newest IDs to the tail. The onyx tag on each tail ID triggers 400 gwei plus 12% of the prior slot's fee, compounding per block.
